description: This file defines serialization utilities for QUICHE wire format, including classes and functions for serializing various data types, computing wire lengths, and handling buffer serialization. It provides an API similar to absl::StrCat() for wire serialization, supporting fixed-size integers, variable-length integers, strings, optionals, and spans.

classes.name: SerializeIntoWriterStatus
classes.description: Template class to deduce the return status type of SerializeIntoWriter() methods, supporting bool and absl::Status.

classes.name: WireFixedSizeIntBase
classes.description: Base class for fixed-size integer wire types (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t).

classes.name: WireUint8
classes.description: Represents an 8-bit unsigned integer for wire serialization.

classes.name: WireUint16
classes.description: Represents a 16-bit unsigned integer for wire serialization.

classes.name: WireUint32
classes.description: Represents a 32-bit unsigned integer for wire serialization.

classes.name: WireUint64
classes.description: Represents a 64-bit unsigned integer for wire serialization.

classes.name: WireVarInt62
classes.description: Represents a 62-bit variable-length integer as per RFC 9000.

classes.name: WireBytes
classes.description: Represents unframed raw string data for wire serialization.

classes.name: WireStringWithLengthPrefix
classes.description: Template class for strings with length prefix of a specified wire type.

classes.name: WireStringWithVarInt62Length
classes.description: Type alias for strings with varint62 length prefix.

classes.name: WireOptional
classes.description: Template class to serialize optional values, writing only if present.

classes.name: WireSpan
classes.description: Template class for serializing multiple entries of the same wire type.

methods.name: SerializeIntoWriterWrapper
methods.description: Wraps serialization with debug checks for length consistency.

methods.name: SerializeIntoWriterCore
methods.description: Internal function to serialize data, handling bool and Status return types.

methods.name: SerializeIntoWriter
methods.description: Serializes multiple data items into a writer, returning Status.

methods.name: ComputeLengthOnWire
methods.description: Calculates total wire length for given data items.

methods.name: SerializeIntoBuffer
methods.description: Allocates buffer and serializes data into it, returning buffer or error.
